content.subject: Step 1: Prefix idempotence in integrate_message
content.description: Strip one leading `tugdash(<name>): ` from the body before wrapping, so the landed subject can never double-prefix. [P03]

content.subject: Step 2: The canonical key resolver, and the reader over it
content.description: Add DashDraftKey / dash_draft_key in tugdash-core; rebuild dash_draft_message over it with the worktree spelling as a bounded legacy probe. [P01][P02][P07]
content.activeForm: Building the canonical dash-draft key resolver

content.subject: Step 3: The CLI writes the base-root key
content.description: tugutil draft set/show/clear resolves a dash owner's project key to the base repo root; worktree spelling rides as a superseded sibling via a new superseded_project_dirs wire field. Owner resolution stays on the cwd spelling.
content.activeForm: Keying dash drafts by the base repository root

content.subject: Step 4: The byte-for-byte landing invariant
content.description: Integration test at the join_in layer: the authored draft is the landed squash message, string-equal, once-prefixed. [P04]

content.subject: Step 5: The base-dirt census at create
content.description: base_working_set_dirt / BaseDirtPath; CreateOutcome gains base_dirt and off_base; CLI renders them. Report only, touch nothing. [P05]
content.activeForm: Adding the base-dirt census to create

content.subject: Step 6: The --carry transplant
content.description: carry_working_set_in: apply every censused path into the worktree (including deletions), then restore the base. Copy-all-before-clean-any; refuse over unmerged paths. [P06] R01

content.subject: Step 7: Release hands the working set back
content.description: release_in returns the worktree's uncommitted work to the base before teardown, refusing to overwrite a conflicting base edit. [P08]
content.activeForm: Making release hand the working set back

content.subject: Step 8: Doctrine prose
content.description: Subsection in tuglaws/dash-work-doctrine.md on starting a dash from a dirty base; close out the join-assessment brief's two addressed items.

content.subject: Step 9: Integration checkpoint
content.description: End-to-end scratch-repo walk: create --carry → round → draft set from the worktree → join_in lands the authored message once-prefixed. Full workspace suite plus app-test-changed.

content.subject: Step 1: The probe reports what it rebuilt
content.description: replay_probe returns ReplayedRounds { head, mapping } with per-round old→new pairs; resolve_conflicts behavior unchanged.

content.subject: Step 2: replay_onto — the gate and the move
content.description: New tugdash-core/src/replay.rs: ReplayOutcome + replay_onto with preconditions and the compare-and-swap reset --keep inside the worktree.

content.subject: Step 3: Bookkeeping — log line and ledger reconcile
content.description: The replayed dash-log line, reconcile_ledger_cells, rewrite_ledger_commit_cell, and the remap round commit.

content.subject: Step 4: The CLI verb
content.description: tugutil dash replay <name> [--json] with Spec S01 exit codes and human output.

content.subject: Step 5: Divergence fields on the snapshot
content.description: base_ahead, base_overlap, last_replay, replay_conflict_paths on DashDetail and the changeset frame.

content.subject: Step 6: The engine — wake, gate, replay, bump
content.description: tugcast/src/feeds/base_motion.rs: pure decide_for_dash, GIT_HEAD subscription, initial sweep, in-flight lock, aggregate bump.

content.subject: Step 7: The conflicted path becomes a turn
content.description: Injection through code_input_tx, the tug_notice opener frame, conflict and mid-plan notice composition, park-and-retry, notified latch.
content.activeForm: Turning a conflicted replay into a turn

content.subject: Step 8: The deck — notice row and divergence marks
content.description: tug_notice in the code-session-store allowlist and its system-origin row; lane marks; at0427 app-test.
content.activeForm: Rendering the notice row and lane marks

content.subject: Step 9: Doctrine prose
content.description: The "When the base moves" section in dash-work-doctrine.md; strike item 3 in join-assessment.md.

content.subject: Step 10: Integration checkpoint
content.description: Workspace suite, vite build, app-test-changed, and the live smoke on the debug instance.
